remarks: Welcome to your dreamy seaside retreat! This 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath duplex is nestled in the Marina Bay waterfront community in Shippan. Imagine waking up just a stone's throw from the beach & only mins away from a variety of shops, parks & restaurants. Sounds too good to be true? Well, it's not! Step inside where you're welcomed by a bright, updated kitchen featuring granite counters & stainless steel appliances. This modern kitchen seamlessly opens to a dining area with sliders leading to a balcony with beautiful, park-like views, or should we say your new favorite spot for morning coffee? The open-concept dining room flows directly into a spacious living room that's perfect for relaxing or entertaining with a cozy fireplace. The main level also features a tastefully updated powder room & extra storage. Head upstairs to find the primary suite which has it all with it's spacious walk-in-closet, modernized en-suite bath & your own private balcony. The large 2nd bedroom is equally inviting, filled with natural light, double closets & access to the gorgeous hall full bth. Laundry conveniently located on the 2nd floor, c/a & natural gas complete the package. As if that's not enough, there's an in-ground pool overlooking the stunning waterfront views. Parking is a breeze with 1 assigned space, a floating space for a 2nd car & plenty of visitor parking. 1.5mi. to the train & I-95, commuting is a piece of cake. Who needs a vacation when you can have a staycation everyday!
